picks.what: Ruined church on the plateau of the abandoned city, photograph
picks.why: the empty grassland of the ruined city with a church ruin; the only candidate that works at card proportions

gaps: P0–P5: nothing (the only old item, #1, is Marr’s 1934 site plan).
notes: Weak set: none of the photos shows the cathedral or the Church of St. Gregory clearly. The north-walls panorama (#2) is the most recognizable image but far too wide (almost 9:1) for a 16:9 card. A better modern view of the cathedral or the walls would be worth finding.
